title: Rectangular QAM Demodulator Baseband
text: 解调矩形 QAM 调制数据，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Noise variance} 指定噪声方差；{M-ary number} 指定调制阶数、{Output type} 输出类型 Integer、{Decision type} 指定解调判决类型 Hard、{Noise variance source} 指定噪声方差源、{Constellation ordering} 指定符号的映射顺序、{Constellation mapping} 指定用户定义的星座映射、{Normalization method} 指定星座的缩放方法 Min. distance between、{Minimum distance} 指定两个最近星座点之间的距离、{Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} 指定平均功率、{Peak power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} 指定最大功率、{Phase offset (rad)} 指定信号星座的旋转、{Output data type} 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal、{Derotate factor} 指定去旋转因子数据类型、{Denormalization factor} 指定反归一化因子数据类型、{Product output} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Rounding mode} 指定定点运算的舍入模式、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Sum} 指定求和数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: QAM 调制信号 scalar | vector

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: 噪声方差 positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Decision type
params.values: 解调判决类型 Hard decision (default) | Log-likelihood ratio | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance
params.values: 噪声方差 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Constellation ordering
params.values: 符号的映射顺序 Binary (default) | Gray | User-defined

params.name: Constellation mapping
params.values: 用户定义的星座映射 [0:15] (default) | vector

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: 星座的缩放方法 Min. distance between symbols (default) | Average Power | Peak Power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: 两个最近星座点之间的距离 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: 信号星座的旋转 0 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Derotate factor
params.values: 去旋转因子数据类型 Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Denormalization factor
params.values: 反归一化因子数据类型 Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Product output
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | fixdt(1,16) |

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 定点运算的舍入模式 Wrap (default) | Saturate

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Sum
params.values: 求和数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16) |
